description: List all body generations for a given make/model/year combination. Returns generation slugs (e.g., "b9" for Audi A4 2020) used as the "generation" input for list-modifications and classified tools.

make.description: Manufacturer slug (e.g., "audi", "bmw"). Get slugs from list-makes.

model.description: Model slug (e.g., "a4", "3-series"). Get slugs from list-models.

year.description: 4-digit model year 1900-2100 (e.g., 2020). Get valid years from list-years.

name: list-generations
